_comment: Content formats for the two Professional outputs. Bold markup inside strings: **text**. Identity fields (name, credentials, contact, education, certifications) are REQUIRED to come from reference/core-resume.docx and reference/background-notes.md — never invented. credentials and certifications are optional; their sidebar sections are omitted when empty. Everything else reuses content already drafted in /tailor-resume (the ATS resume and the step 6 letter draft).

colors._comment: OPTIONAL in either content JSON below. 6-digit hex, with or without #. sidebar = sidebar band + main-column headings and names; accent = sidebar headings, bullets, rules, and the thin edge stripe. Omitted or invalid values fall back to the defaults shown here (navy / muted gold). Sidebar text is white, so pick a dark sidebar color. Use the same colors in both files so the two documents match.
